ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the types of fraudulent activities and the impact on the state's child care system.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What are the most common types of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to child care fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover significant waste and abuse in the child care system, highlighting the need for increased oversight and accountability.
